products.body:
You thought Team Rocket was done for? Think again. With the “Rockets Mewtwo-ex” League Battle Deck, the original troublemakers are back – and this time, you’re calling the shots.

Inside this box you’ll find a complete, ready-to-play 60-card deck, German edition cards, built around the mighty Mewtwo-ex straight from Team Rocket’s shady labs. Included are 6 holographic cards that shine not only on the battlefield, but also in any collection.

You get everything you need to jump right into the Pokémon TCG: 6 damage-counter dice, 1 coin-flip die for those game-changing moments, 2 Special Condition markers (for when your opponent ends up burned, asleep or just generally doomed), a stylish deck box for on the go, and a strategy guide to help you get the most out of your deck.

Whether you’re about to enter the League for the first time or want to hit your next tournament with a heavy dose of nostalgia and power, this League Battle Deck gives you a well-tuned deck that’s ready to play right out of the box. Team Rocket is blasting off again – straight into your opponent’s defeat.
